summary: ChatProgress: the clock lane is a 40px MINIMUM that never wraps (issue #52). A live duration past a minute ("1 min 12 s", German "1 Min. 12 s") is about 60px of caption; the fixed w-10 broke it onto two lines and grew the root row mid-run. Clock is now min-w-10 whitespace-nowrap on every row (root, steps, lanes), matching the status row's clock; short durations still occupy exactly 40px, so every lane stays aligned. A long clock grows leftward into the label, which truncates.
